operations.description: This operation creates a stream target. There are three types of targets that you can create: CustomStreamTarget for an an external, third-party destination; WowzaStreamTarget for a Wowza CDN target; or UltraLowLatencyStreamTarget for an ultra low latency Wowza CDN target. The availability of many parameters depends on the type of target you create.
